summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier) and SHACLPathError(Exception), following the seven-step procedure in the spec. Added test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with one parametrized test over valid and invalid shapes, plus tests for non-node inputs and for the graph being left unchanged. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (42 passed) under the shared venv. No existing files changed and nothing was committed. Not verified: mypy and ruff are not installed in the shared venv, so type-checking and formatting were checked by reading the code and by line-length checks only. The full test suite was not run.
